transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I finally came in because I feel like the part of me that used to reach out to people and enjoy things has gone quiet. Work, yoga, going to galleries, even journaling—I used to get something from them. Now I mostly just move through my obligations.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
About eight months now. It really started around when we took my older relative into our apartment, and since then I’ve noticed this change in how I think, work, and connect with people.
Before these past eight months, had you ever experienced a similar period of feeling this way?
No, I don’t think so. I’ve had stressful periods before, but not this same kind of ongoing feeling of being disconnected from things.
Along with losing interest in things, have you also been feeling down, sad, or empty most days?
I’m not sure I’d call it sadness. I just feel sort of flat, I guess—like I’m going through the motions.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns over these past several months?
I haven’t really noticed a clear change in my sleep. It seems about the same to me.
How have your energy levels been over these past several months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a big change in my energy levels, at least not one I can clearly point to.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite over these past several months?
I don’t think so. My appetite seems pretty much the same as usual.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making decisions?

Yeah, I think so. I’m still going to work, but I’ve missed some grant deadlines, and my supervisor has moved a few of my more demanding clients to other clinicians. I’m not functioning at my usual level.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness, self-blame, or excessive guilt?
I wouldn’t say I’ve had strong feelings like that. I’ve been frustrated with myself at times, but not really overwhelmed by guilt or feeling worthless.
Have you had any thoughts of death, dying, or hurting yourself?
No, I haven’t had thoughts about dying or hurting myself.
